summary: Bryant scored only 14.3 on Wednesday, below the 22 threshold: move the captain to Maledon before 20:00 tonight. Fallback if Maledon is out: Feliz (tonight), then Ndiaye (Fri).
Tonight: Maledon and Feliz at Maccabi (20:05), Ojeleye and Davidovac at Partizan (20:45). Friday: Jackson (19:00), Ndiaye (20:15), Etienne and Faye (20:45).
If Ojeleye or Davidovac is left out tonight, put Ndiaye (Fri) in the starting five or as 6th man before 20:45.

Paris guards Hifi and Ntilikina are uncertain again for Friday: good for Etienne's minutes.
